title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Minimum Payment and Payment Due Date Terms by Tier
content:
The figures below set, for each Ridgeline Consumer Credit tier, the inputs of the minimum payment due on a statement and the distance from the statement closing date to the payment due date.

| | Card Classic | Card Preferred | Card Premier | Project Loan 66 | Project Loan 78 | Project Loan 84 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum payment percentage of the new statement balance | 3.5 | 3.0 | 2.5 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| Minimum payment floor (USD) | 35.00 | 35.00 | 29.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Unpaid past-due amount added to the minimum | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Days from statement closing date to payment due date (calendar days) | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 |

## What each line means

- **Minimum payment percentage** — the percentage of the new statement balance used in the minimum payment on a revolving card. It is 0.0 on the Ridgeline Project Loan tiers, whose minimum is an installment rather than a percentage.
- **Minimum payment floor** — the lowest minimum payment due on a revolving statement whose balance is at or above the floor; a smaller balance is due in full. It is 0.00 on the installment loans.
- **Past-due amount added** — on every tier, any unpaid past-due amount from the prior statement is added to the minimum payment due.
- **Due date distance** — the payment due date falls 25 calendar days after the statement closing date on every tier.

## Hypothetical reading

A Card Premier statement and a Card Classic statement with the same balance carry different inputs: Premier uses 2.5 percent with a 29.00 floor, Classic uses 3.5 percent with a 35.00 floor.
